texts.at-0002: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and put the offending value in the detail string.
texts.at-0003: Exclude bool when validating integer arguments When validating an integer parameter, check `isinstance(x, bool)` first because `bool` is a subclass of `int`; reject bools along with non-ints and out-of-range values.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly/clock.py` before comparing or doing arithmetic; it rejects naive datetimes with a BillingError. Follow the pattern used in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py:current_period`.

candidate.title: Compute periods via floor division on timedelta
candidate.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the same way as `ledgerly/subscriptions.py:current_period`: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)`, `n = (at - start) // length`, then `start + n * length`. Reuse this idiom instead of inventing new date math.

n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
